sql.state.getAllStates: select s.id, s.state, s.abbreviation, s.time_zone_abbreviation, s.map_latitude, s.map_longitude, s.map_zoom from flow.state s order by s.state
sql.state.getActiveStatesByCompany: select s.id, s.state, s.abbreviation, s.time_zone_abbreviation, cs.active, case when cs.map_latitude is not null then cs.map_latitude else s.map_latitude end as map_latitude, case when cs.map_longitude is not null then cs.map_longitude else s.map_longitude end as map_longitude, case when cs.map_zoom is not null then cs.map_zoom else s.map_zoom end as map_zoom from flow.company_state cs inner join flow.state s on s.id = cs.state_id where cs.active is true and cs.company_id = :companyId order by s.state
